paragraphs.text: Open Season 3 is a 2010 American animated comedy film directed by Cody Cameron. It is the third installment in the Open Season film series. In the film, when Boog the grizzly bear accidentally switches places with a lookalike circus grizzly named Doug, it is up to his best friend Elliot the mule deer and the other animals to rescue him before the circus returns to Russia.
Open Season 3 was released direct-to-video in the United States on January 25, 2011. The film received negative reviews from critics and grossed $7 million.

DVD Verdict gave the film a negative review, saying: "This tiresomely predictable tale exemplifies everything that's wrong about straight-to-DVD animated sequels to big-budget mainstream films: the plot is utterly predictable and rehashes a lot of beats from the original effort, the major voice actors have been replaced by poor substitutes and the quality of the animation has dropped dramatically (most of the visuals are on the level of a video game or one of those cheap CGI Saturday morning TV shows)".
